set.body: Epic: bd-01KWW00VNSYZGKMA2NN1VFWN2J. Add a typed decoder-only BOLDZip-style payload before porting the encoder: temporal basis, carriers, texture loadings, residual events, spatial basis descriptors, and deterministic decode algebra. Acceptance: Scala decoder matches a small independent fixture and supports time/ROI selection without assuming the R voxels-by-time public API.
